candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from order's calls to payment timing out: traces show POST payment to /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout (~2s) while inventory/redis calls succeed, and gateway /v1/checkout p95 is ~2406ms with 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side latency metrics/logs not admitted; timeout could be payment slowness or network. Logs excluded from context.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show order->payment ReadTimeout causing checkout 502s while inventory/redis succeed; gateway metrics show elevated checkout p95 and 502s. Bounded candidate is downstream payment latency, but payment-side telemetry is missing, so confidence is moderate.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics to confirm payment-side slowness vs network timeout
Gateway/order logs (ev-...-gateway_logs) excluded from context; needed to confirm timeout origin
